modes.title: Pick your adventure
modes.text: In the lobby, just talk to a figure in the village – and you're in the game. Empty modes sleep and wake up as soon as someone arrives.
modes.empty: No game modes have been added yet.
modes.joinText: Add the address, arrive in the Alpine village and talk to a figure at the market – and you are in the game.
modes.howText: You reach every game mode from the lobby in the Alpine village – in three small steps.
modes.stepFigure: Talk to the figure at the village market

modeLookText.asleep: Asleep – wakes up as soon as you arrive.
modeLookText.pause: Summer break right now – competitions run from 1 December to 31 March. You can still visit the village.

mode.asleepText: This mode is asleep because nobody is in it. As soon as you arrive it wakes up – that takes a short moment.
mode.whitelistText: Invitation only: you need a spot on the whitelist. Ask on Discord.

notNow.soon: Not open yet – still being built.

mode.pauseText: Summer break: no competitions until winter. The ice rink, chairlift and toboggan run in the village are still open – feel free to drop by.

team.title: The team
team.text: These people keep the network running. If you have questions, talk to them in the game or on Discord.
team.soon: The team will introduce itself soon.
team.helpText: Need help or want to report something? The quickest way is a ticket on Discord.
team.searchText: Fancy helping to shape MoinMorni? Apply – with Discord sign-in, in a few minutes.

rules.title: Rules
rules.text: So everyone feels at home: these rules apply everywhere on MoinMorni – in every game mode and on our Discord.
rules.empty: The rules will appear here as soon as the team has added them.
rules.punishTitle: Punishments apply in the game and on Discord
rules.punishText: If you break the rules, you can be warned, muted or banned. A punishment applies on the whole network and on our Discord too – a ban in the game is also a ban on Discord.

community.discordText: Chat, find people to play with, join events and get help – and link your Minecraft account so your rank shines there too.

help.title: Help
help.text: Everything you need to get started – explained in short. Click a topic to open it.
help.stillStuck: Didn't find what you were looking for? The team is happy to help:

join.title: How to join
join.short: Add the address – with Java or Bedrock
join.intro: MoinMorni works with the Java Edition (PC) and the Bedrock Edition (phone, console, Windows). All you need is your Minecraft – there's no sign-up with us.
join.java3: Enter this as the server address:
join.java4: Done! Double-click the server – and you're in the lobby.
join.javaVersions: Works with every version from 1.17 up to the newest.
join.bedrock2: Switch to the “Servers” tab and tap “Add Server”.
join.consoles: Some consoles don't have an “Add Server” button. Ask on Discord – we'll help you.

voice.title: Voice chat
voice.short: Talk to others – across all game modes
voice.intro: On MoinMorni you can talk to others: to people near you, to your party, or in fixed channels that are the same in every game mode. For this you need the free mod “Simple Voice Chat” (Java only).
voice.step1: Install the mod for your Minecraft version:
voice.step2: Start Minecraft with the mod and join MoinMorni – the voice chat connects by itself.
voice.step3b: key opens the voice chat settings (test your microphone, volume),
voice.step3c: opens the groups. To talk, hold the push-to-talk key – or switch to voice activation in the settings.
voice.channelsText: Reachable from every game mode. Show, join and leave channels:
voice.bedrock: Sadly there's no voice chat with the Bedrock Edition (phone, console) – Bedrock can't do it.

discord.title: Link Discord
discord.short: Link your Minecraft account with Discord
discord.intro: If you link your Minecraft account with our Discord, you get your rank there too – and the team can help you faster.
discord.step0Soon: Join our Discord – the invite will be here soon.
discord.step2: You get a code. Then type on Discord:
discord.step3: Done – your rank appears on Discord and follows by itself when it changes.

modes.title: Game modes
modes.short: All modes at a glance – and how to get there
modes.intro: You reach every game mode from the lobby: the figures at the village market around the maypole and at the castle market in front of the castle stairs take you there with one click. The compass in your hotbar is even quicker.
modes.sleep: When nobody is in a mode, it sleeps. As soon as you arrive it wakes up – that takes a little moment.
modes.pause: Winter Games can take a summer break: then there are competitions only in winter (1 December to 31 March) – the village with ice rink, lift and toboggan run stays open.

mornicraft.title: Apply for MorniCraft
mornicraft.intro: MorniCraft is our friends’ survival. To keep it cosy, only people on the whitelist get in. How to get a spot:
mornicraft.step1: Open the application page and sign in with Discord (we only see your Discord name).
mornicraft.step2: Enter your Minecraft name and tell us a bit about yourself.
mornicraft.step3: The team reads your application and answers you with a Discord message.
mornicraft.step4: Rather apply directly in Discord? That works too – type there

commands.title: Commands
commands.intro: Type commands in the chat (key T) – with a slash in front.
commands.tab: Tip: with the Tab key, Minecraft completes commands and names for you.

rules.title: Rules & punishments
rules.short: What applies – and what happens if not
rules.intro: Our rules: be kind, don't cheat, don't spam. All rules are on their own page.
rules.punish: Punishments like mutes or bans apply on the whole network – and on our Discord too.

team.title: Help from the team
team.short: Ticket on Discord – or ask in the game
team.intro: Stuck, found a bug or want to report someone? We are happy to help. In the game you can tell the team by the symbol in front of the name, e.g. ✚ Supporter or ⚔ Moderator.
team.step1: On our Discord, go to the “hilfe” (help) channel.
team.step2: Click the button to open a ticket – only you and the team can see it.
team.step3: Briefly describe what's going on. Someone from the team will get back to you.

village.title: Welcome to the village
village.text: Our lobby is a whole Alpine village: a market, a beer garden, lanes to wander and a castle on the mountain. You can walk into every house.
village.timeLabel: Time of day in the pictures

dorfplatz.title: The village market
dorfplatz.text: This is where you arrive: the colourful stalls of the game modes stand around the maypole, behind them the stairs lead up to the castle.
dorfplatz.alt: The village market with maypole and colourful stalls, the castle behind

stand.title: The figures at the market
stand.text: A figure waits at every stall. Above its head: the name, the number of players and whether the mode is awake. Right-click – and you are in.
stand.alt: A market stall with a red and white roof and a figure behind it

biergarten.title: The beer garden
biergarten.text: Under the chestnut trees the landlord serves, the regulars sit at the benches. Meet your friends here – also in the voice channel “Biergarten”.
biergarten.alt: The beer garden with benches under big trees

gasse.title: The craftsmen’s lane
gasse.text: Smithy, joinery, bakery: every house is furnished and open. Take a look around – some hide little secrets.
gasse.alt: A lane between wooden houses with green shutters and lanterns

schloss.title: The castle
schloss.short: At the top of the mountain
schloss.text: Launch pads fly you up the stairs. The parkour spiral with its leaderboard waits at the castle.
schloss.alt: The white castle with green tower roofs on the mountain

karte.title: The village from above
karte.text: Market, lanes, beer garden, upper village and castle – this is our village from the air.
karte.alt: The whole village seen from above

mornicraft.tip1: Apply on the website or on Discord – with a place on the whitelist you are in.
mornicraft.tip2: You start on the spawn island high above the sea: double-jump and you glide off with the starter elytra.
mornicraft.tip3: Found a clan with friends, set your clan base – and take on the mighty ender dragon together.

cmd.home: Go to your home (save it with /sethome).
cmd.tpa: Ask whether you may teleport to someone.
cmd.clan: Clan menu: found, invite, base, colour.
cmd.sethome: Remembers where you stand as a home.
cmd.homes: Your homes as beds to click.
cmd.back: Back to the last place – also after dying.
cmd.tpahere: Ask someone to come to you.
cmd.clanCreate: Found your own clan, with a tag (2–4 characters).
cmd.mail: A message for later – also to people who are offline.
cmd.afk: Tell everyone you're away for a moment.
cmd.info: All of MorniCraft's commands in the game.
cmd.leiste: Show or hide the bar on the right.
cmd.streamer: Streamer mode: hide addresses, coordinates and messages.
cmd.ansehen: A player's team menu (also sneak + right click).
cmd.einfrieren: Freeze someone or thaw them again.
cmd.nether: Build the nether portal at the spawn (or take it away with “weg”).
cmd.end: Build the way to the end portal in the spawn (or take it away).
cmd.mcadmin: Reload MorniCraft (settings otherwise arrive from the panel by themselves).

duels.tip1: Pick a fighting style: classic with mushroom soup, modern or with abilities.
duels.tip2: Play casual or ranked – ranked fights count for the leaderboard.
duels.tip3: With friends: challenge them directly or go 2v2 as a party.

cmd.kit: Your own layout in the kit editor.

party.tip1: 2 to 8 people take turns rolling the dice across a game board and collect coins.
party.tip2: The wandering stall sells edelweiss – whoever has the most at the end wins.
party.tip3: After every round comes a quick minigame – the best get coins.

cmd.mitspielen: Sign up for the next game.

gipfelsturm.tip1: Eight parkour courses from easy to extreme – pick one at the base camp.
gipfelsturm.tip2: The clock runs to the millisecond; at checkpoints you see whether you beat your best time.
gipfelsturm.tip3: Every week there is a course of the week with its own leaderboard.

burgverlies.tip1: Alone or with up to three friends you descend three floors below the castle.
burgverlies.tip2: Every room is different: fights, traps, puzzles, treasure – and you gear up at the merchant.
burgverlies.tip3: If someone is down, crouch to revive them – the dungeon master waits at the very bottom.

bollwerk.tip1: 1 to 6 people defend the village together – vote on the map in the guard room.
bollwerk.tip2: Between the waves you shop at the general store and build arrow towers, palisades and healing banners.
bollwerk.tip3: Every five waves a giant comes – how far can you get?

cmd.bereit: Say you are ready – in a round, start the next wave.
cmd.shop: General store during the build phase.

mirni.tip1: You start in the floating market town – the three travel gates lead to the overworld, Nether and End.
mirni.tip2: Trade with everyone: auction house, orders, your own shop chests and market stalls to rent.
mirni.tip3: Claim your land – coins only exist in the game, nothing for real money.

cmd.rtp: A random safe spot to start.
cmd.gs: Claim the chunk you stand in.

wolkenkampf.tip1: In the cloud harbour you vote on map and mode and pick your free starter kit.
wolkenkampf.tip2: From the balloon gondola you float down to your own island: loot chests, build bridges, fight.
wolkenkampf.tip3: Supplies, a thunderstorm and rising fog make for the finale – the last one standing wins.

versteckerl.tip1: About one in four becomes a village constable – everyone else hides as a hay bale, barrel or flower pot.
versteckerl.tip2: Stand still for three seconds: you lock in as a real block and become almost impossible to spot.
versteckerl.tip3: Whistling earns points but gives you away – and whoever is found joins the search.

wintersport.tip1: In the mountain village you vote: the whole competition or a single event.
wintersport.tip2: Giant slalom by boat through the gates, biathlon with shooting range and penalty loops, bobsleigh – parties ride a two-man bob.
wintersport.tip3: Gold, silver and bronze are handed out at the podium. Until it starts: ice rink, chairlift and toboggan run.

cmd.abstimmen: Choose the competition or an event.

adlerflug.tip1: At the eagle’s eyrie you choose a course and run down the ski jump – the wings open by themselves.
adlerflug.tip2: Steer with the mouse: down makes you faster, up makes you climb. Fly through all rings in order.
adlerflug.tip3: Updrafts lift you, boost rings give you speed – bronze, silver, gold or even eagle?

angelkoenig.tip1: Just drop by whenever you like – there are no rounds. Cast, wait, reel in.
angelkoenig.tip2: Four fishing spots with 20 kinds of fish – time of day and weather change what bites.
angelkoenig.tip3: Sell your catch to fishmonger Xaver and win the royal crown at the tournament on the quarter hour.

cmd.fischbuch: What you have caught so far.

commands.title: Commands
commands.text: Everything you can type into the chat: for everyone in the network, for each game mode and for the team. Click a command to copy it.
commands.textFor: Only what {{name}} really may as {{rank}}. Click a command to copy it.
commands.unknown: We don't know a player called “{{name}}” yet – here are all commands.
commands.everyoneText: These commands work on every server in the network – in the lobby and in every game mode.
commands.modeText: Only on {{name}}. The commands for everyone work there too, of course.
commands.teamText: Who may do what depends on the rank – the ranks are next to each command. Punishments only go to lower ranks.
commands.teamTextFor: This is what you may do as {{rank}}. Punishments only go to lower ranks.
commands.settingsText: Every setting from the panel also works as a command. Without a value, the command shows all settings of its area and how to change them.

lines.lobby: Back to the lobby – from anywhere. In the middle of a round we ask once more, a second /lobby counts as yes.
lines.server: Straight into a game mode, e.g. /server duels.
lines.freunde: Which of your friends are online right now – and where.
lines.party: Invite friends to your party – the party follows you into every game mode.
lines.partyAnnehmen: Accept an invitation to a party.
lines.partyLeiter: Hand over the party lead (leader only).
lines.pc: Write a message only to your party.
lines.r: Reply to the last private message.
lines.voice: All voice channels and how many people are in them.
lines.voiceKanal: Join a voice channel or group.
lines.voiceGruppe: Open your own voice group for all servers – with a password only for those you invite.
lines.voiceZu: Join a player in their voice group – without a password.
lines.profil: Make your profile on the website private or public.
lines.discord: An invitation to our Discord – and a code to link your account.
lines.rundgang: A tour through the village (stop: /tour stop).
lines.parkour: The leaderboard of the parkour spiral and your best time.
lines.parkourStart: To the start of the parkour spiral.
lines.musik: Turn the lobby music off and on for you. A brass band plays on normal days, Bavarian music at Oktoberfest, carols in winter – with our lobby pack a real band, otherwise note blocks.
lines.musikLauter: Make the lobby music quieter or louder (also as a number from 0 to 100). The “Jukebox/Note Blocks” slider in Minecraft's settings works too.
lines.warn: Warn someone – it shows in their punishment history.
lines.strafen: See all punishments of a player.
lines.mute: Mute in the chat, e.g. for 30m, 2h, 7d or perm.
lines.voiceunmute: Let them speak in the voice chat again.
lines.kick: Kick from the network (they may come back right away).
lines.gefaengnis: Into the cell under the lobby's town hall – ten minutes without a duration.
lines.ban: Lock out of the whole network – Discord included.
lines.rang: Give or take a rank – only ranks below your own.
lines.rueckkehr: Lost your connection mid-game? While your spot is still free, this takes you back to your round (the item in the lobby does the same).

login.title: Team area
login.subtitle: Sign in with your MoinMorni account.
login.passkeyHint: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, face or a security key – no password needed.
login.twoFactorText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.forTeam: For the team only. You do not need an account to play.

notInTeam.title: You are not on the team (yet)
notInTeam.text: You are signed in, but you have no role in MoinMorni yet. Ask the owner to give you one – then you can continue here.

gate.errorTitle: The panel is not answering right now

setup.title: Welcome to MoinMorni!
setup.text: Create your owner account. You will manage the whole network with it.
setup.codeHelp: The installation script showed the setup code. Lost it? This command on the server shows it:
setup.usernameHelp: 3–32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.
setup.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters – a whole sentence is easier to remember and safe.
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.nameInvalid: The name does not fit yet: 3–32 characters, only letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.
setup.passwordShort: The password needs at least 10 characters.
setup.doneText: There is an owner account already. Just sign in.

overview.text: How the network is doing, at a glance.
overview.proxyOff: The network's entrance (proxy) is not running right now – players cannot join.

settings.missing: This area does not exist – or you may not see it.
settings.savedMode: Saved – applies after the mode’s next restart (as soon as nobody is playing).
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
settings.ownerOnlyLocked: Only the owner can change this – you see how it's set.

modes.title: Modes
modes.text: Which game modes exist, their order in the lobby and on the website, and who may join.
modes.stateHelp: “Soon” already shows the mode, but nobody can join yet.
modes.sleepHelp: When nobody is inside, the server goes to sleep and saves memory. It wakes up as soon as someone clicks the villager.

roles.title: Roles
roles.text: A role applies everywhere: symbol and colour in chat, rights in game, areas in the panel and the matching role in Discord.
roles.howTo: Unfold a role to change it. Only “Save” applies everything – then it counts right away in the game, the panel and Discord.
roles.ownerOnlyNote: Only the owner can change Owner and Admin.
roles.mighty: Careful: gives a lot of power
roles.symbolHelp: Shown before the name in chat, in the player list and above the head. At most 4 characters.
roles.colourHelp: Colour of the name in chat and above the head – as #rrggbb.
roles.colourInvalid: The colour does not fit yet: please as #rrggbb, e.g. #55ff55.
roles.fallbackHelp: Everyone without another rank has this one. Exactly one role is it – switch it on for another role to move it.
roles.deleteHelp: Whoever has this role gets the rank for everyone else afterwards.

cantDelete.fallback: The role for everyone else stays – make another role the default first.

roles.locked: Only the owner can change Owner and Admin.
roles.newHint: Give the role a name. You set symbol, colour and rights afterwards.
roles.newHelp: The ID will be “{{id}}” – it stays even if you change the name later.
roles.saved: Roles saved – they apply everywhere right away.
roles.fixFirst: Please check first: {{names}} (name, symbol or colour does not fit yet).

gameHelp.ban: Lock players out for a while or forever.
gameHelp.jail: Put players into the jail in the lobby.
gameHelp.warn: Give a warning that stays in the history.
gameHelp.teleport: Teleport to players or bring them over.
gameHelp.vanish: Become invisible to others, e.g. to watch.
gameHelp.inspect: See other players' inventory and details.
gameHelp.voice-join-any: Join any voice group without a password.
gameHelp.build: Place and break blocks where it is protected otherwise.
gameHelp.worldedit: Big building tools (whole areas at once).
gameHelp.lobby-edit: Build in the lobby (in creative mode).
gameHelp.gamemode: Change the game mode (survival, adventure, spectator) – creative only with “Creative mode”.
gameHelp.streamer: Streamer mode: hides addresses and coordinates.
gameHelp.reserved-slot: May join even when the network is full.
gameHelp.bigger-party: A bigger party with more friends.
gameHelp.lobby-extras: Extras in the lobby, e.g. particles or hats.

gameHelp.admin: Everything in the game on every server, like an operator – only for very few.

discordHelp.administrator: May really do everything in Discord.
discordHelp.manage-server: Change channels, roles and settings of the Discord server.
discordHelp.manage-messages: Delete and pin other people's messages.
discordHelp.timeout: Give people a time-out (they cannot write for a while).
discordHelp.media-area: Sees the channels for streamers and videos.

servers.title: Servers
servers.text: All of MoinMorni's Minecraft servers: console, files, backups, plugins and more – click a server.
servers.empty: No servers yet. MoinMorni creates them itself when it sets up the network.
servers.motorSignedOut: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.text: This page does not exist in the panel.

panel.forbidden: Your role may not see this area. Ask the owner if you need it.

players.title: Players
players.text: Everyone who has ever been on MoinMorni – with rank, play time and punishments. Whoever is online right now is at the top.
players.searchHint: Tip: names of Bedrock players (phone, console) start with a dot, e.g. “.Tobi_04”.
players.limitHint: These are the {{count}} most recently active. Search for a name to find others.
players.empty: Nobody has been here yet. As soon as someone joins the network, they show up here.
players.noMatch: Nobody with “{{q}}” in their name. Check the spelling.
players.bedrockHelp: Plays the Bedrock Edition (phone, console or Windows).
players.unknown: MoinMorni does not know this player (any more).
players.uuidHelp: Stays the same even when the name changes.

rank.title: Rank
rank.savedNone: {{name}} no longer has an own rank.
rank.team: Counts as {{rank}} right now because the Minecraft account is linked to a team account in the panel. The higher rank always wins – the own rank here applies once the person leaves the team.
rank.higher: {{name}} has the same or a higher rank than you – you cannot change this rank.
rank.noRight: Only people with the right “Give ranks” may give ranks (like /rank in the game). VIP is given by the owner only.
rank.noRoles: Ranks can be given by people who may also see the roles in the panel.
rank.help: You can only give ranks below your own. Only the owner gives Owner, Admin and VIP. Applies in the game right away.
rank.locked: You may not give this rank – it is as high as yours or higher (only the owner gives Owner, Admin and VIP).

act.title: Punish
act.help: Applies across the whole network right away. The team gets a note.
act.higher: {{name}} has the same or a higher rank than you – only someone with a higher rank can punish here.
act.protectedOne: {{name}} is {{rank}} – only the {{who}} may do that. Punishments only go to lower ranks.
act.protectedMany: {{name}} is {{rank}} – only {{who}} may do that. Punishments only go to lower ranks.
act.protectedNobody: {{name}} is {{rank}} – nobody may punish this rank.

history.title: History
history.empty: A clean record so far – no punishments.

punish.noRight: Your role lacks the right for this – just like the command in the game.
punish.title: New punishment
punish.text: Applies across the whole network right away – the person sees the reason, the team gets a note.
punish.playerHelp: The name as shown in the game. The person must have been on the network at least once.
punish.kickOffline: Kicking only works while {{name}} is online.
punish.customInvalid: Please enter a whole number from 1 (at most 10 years).
punish.reasonHelp: The person sees it. Leaving it empty is fine – then it says “no reason given”.

summary.ban: {{name}} is removed from the network right away and cannot join for {{duration}}.
summary.banForever: {{name}} is removed from the network right away and cannot join any more – until someone lifts the ban.
summary.muteForever: {{name}} cannot write in chat any more – until someone lifts the mute.
summary.voice: {{name}} cannot speak in voice chat for {{duration}} – on every server. Writing in chat still works. Discord: muted in voice channels too if the account is linked.
summary.voiceForever: {{name}} cannot speak in voice chat until someone lifts it – on every server. Writing in chat still works. Discord: muted in voice channels too if the account is linked.
summary.warn: {{name}} sees the warning in the game (if online). It stays in the history.
summary.kick: {{name}} is removed from the network right away, but can join again straight away.
summary.jail: {{name}} goes to the lobby jail cell for {{duration}}: no game modes, can only write to the team. Discord: jail role.
summary.jailForever: {{name}} goes to the lobby jail cell until someone releases them: no game modes, can only write to the team. Discord: jail role.

done.voice: {{name}} is muted in voice chat now.

lifted.voice: {{name}} may speak in voice chat again.

punishments.title: Punishments
punishments.text: All punishments in the network – bans, chat and voice chat mutes, jail, warnings and kicks. You can lift active ones here.
punishments.empty: No punishments yet – the network is behaving nicely.
punishments.liftHigher: Only someone with a higher rank than {{name}} can lift this.

tour.again: You can start the tour again any time – at the bottom left, next to your name.

overview.title: Welcome to the panel!
overview.text: Fancy a quick tour? The overview shows at a glance whether the network is running, how many players are online and which modes are open.

modes.title: Modes
modes.text: Switch game modes on and off here, put them into maintenance and choose their order in the lobby.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Everything for the network, sorted by area – chat, voice chat, lobby and below them every game mode (Duels, Morni Party …). Each settings page has a search at the top, and every field shows the matching command in case you prefer changing it in the game. A game mode’s settings apply after its next restart – MoinMorni does that by itself as soon as nobody is playing. Under Lobby → Music you set up the lobby music (which pieces play in each season). Under “Reachability” you connect NetBird: website and game right on the domain, and your home address stays hidden.

news.title: News
news.text: Write news for the website here – as a draft or published right away. Published news also goes to Discord.

players.title: Players
players.text: Everyone who has ever been here: search, view profiles with play time and give ranks.

punishments.title: Punishments
punishments.text: Warn, mute in chat or voice chat, jail, ban or kick – and lift it all again. Applies across the whole network and on Discord right away.

roles.title: Roles
roles.text: Symbol, colour and rights of every role – in the game on every server (up to the admin commands of the game modes), in the panel and on Discord. A change applies everywhere at once.

discord.title: Discord
discord.text: Connect your own Discord bot (enter its token right here), let it set up your Discord server step by step and change the server picture, banner and the bot's profile under “Look”.

servers.title: Servers
servers.text: The single Minecraft servers with console, files, backups and plugins. Look here when something is stuck.

team.title: Team
team.text: Create panel accounts here, give everyone a role and help out when someone forgot their password. Your own account is at the bottom left, next to your name.

applications.title: Applications
applications.text: Applications for the team (moderator, supporter, builder …) and for MorniCraft – from the website and from Discord. Read the answers, give a thumbs up or down, write notes for the team and accept or reject. Which positions are open, you set under Settings → Team applications.

newsAdmin.title: News
newsAdmin.text: Write news for the website. Published news appears on the start page right away – and the first time it's published, also on Discord in #ankündigungen.
newsAdmin.empty: No news written yet. The first one appears big on the start page.
newsAdmin.deleteText: “{{title}}” will disappear from the website. This can't be undone.
newsAdmin.editorText: Just start writing: every line becomes its own paragraph on the website. On the right you see how it looks.
newsAdmin.categoryHelp: Update = something new in the game, Event = something with a date, Info = everything else.
newsAdmin.titlePlaceholder: e.g. New game mode: Summit Rush
newsAdmin.bodyPlaceholder: What's new? Every line becomes a paragraph.
newsAdmin.bodyEnPlaceholder: Leave empty: then English visitors see the German text.
newsAdmin.bodyHelp: Text only – every line becomes a paragraph.
newsAdmin.englishHelp: English is optional. If a field stays empty, English visitors see the German text.
newsAdmin.pinHelp: Always stays at the top of the website – and big on the start page.
newsAdmin.discordHint: “Publish” shows the post on the website right away – and also sends it to Discord #ankündigungen. A draft stays hidden.
newsAdmin.publishedHint: Already published: changes appear on the website right away (the first message on Discord stays). “Save as draft” takes the post off the website.
newsAdmin.savedPublished: Published – it's on the website now and goes to Discord.
newsAdmin.previewFallback: Without an English text, English visitors see the German one.

discordAdmin.title: Discord
discordAdmin.text: MoinMorni has its own Discord bot. Connect it here, let it set up your Discord server and choose how everything looks.

missing.text: There is no bot token yet. Start with step 1.

tokenInvalid.text: Discord doesn't know the saved token. Create a new one in the developer portal and enter it in step 1.

connecting.text: The bot is connecting to Discord. That usually takes just a few seconds.

noGuild.text: The bot is online but not on a Discord server yet. Create one and invite the bot (steps 3 and 4).

running.text: The bot is setting up “{{guild}}” right now. Step 5 below shows how far it got.

intent.text: The bot is on “{{guild}}”, but “Server Members Intent” is off. Without it, it can't welcome new members (step 2).

ready.text: The bot is on “{{guild}}” and ready. One click in step 5 creates roles, channels and messages.

done.text: The bot runs on “{{guild}}”: status, ranks, punishments, tickets and applications are connected.

check.tokenInvalid: The token is wrong – please create a new one in the developer portal.
check.login: “Sign in with Discord” on the website
check.loginOptional: Optional – for applications on the website (step 6)

steps.title: How to set up Discord
steps.text: Go through it once – after that, the bot does the rest by itself. This page checks every 10 seconds what already worked.

s1.title: Create the bot and enter its token
s1.c: On the left, “Bot”, then “Reset Token” and copy the token.
s1.d: Paste it here. MoinMorni asks Discord right away whether it's right and stores it encrypted.

s2.title: Two switches in the developer portal
s2.intent: Under “Bot” → “Privileged Gateway Intents”, turn on “Server Members Intent”.
s2.public: Also under “Bot”, turn off “Public Bot” – then only you can invite the bot.
s2.why: With the first switch the bot welcomes new members and gives out ranks. Then click “Save Changes” at the bottom.

s3.title: Create an empty Discord server
s3.text: In Discord, click “+” on the left → “Create My Own”. Discord no longer lets bots create servers – so you do this once by hand. Leave it empty, the bot does the rest.

s4.title: Invite the bot
s4.text: Click the button, pick your new server and confirm.
s4.rights: The bot only asks for these rights:
s4.noAdmin: No administrator right – only what it needs for roles, channels, the server picture, punishments and tickets.
s4.button: Bring the bot to your Discord server
s4.noLink: The button shows up as soon as the bot token is right (step 1).

s5.title: Set up the server
s5.text: One click – the bot creates roles, channels, messages and commands and sets the server picture. You see every step here.
s5.again: Already set up. “Sync again” brings everything up to date. Whatever you renamed or moved in Discord stays that way – nothing is created twice or deleted.
s5.roleTip: Tip: the bot's role (it's named like the bot) must sit above every rank it should give out – in Discord under Server Settings → Roles.

s6.title: Sign in with Discord (website)
s6.text: People who apply on the website sign in with Discord. For that, MoinMorni needs your application's “Client Secret”.
s6.b: On the left, “OAuth2”; under “Redirects”, “Add Redirect”, paste this address and “Save Changes”:
s6.c: On the same page, next to “Client Secret”, click “Reset Secret”, copy it and paste it here:

result.communityFailed: The bot couldn't turn on community mode – you can do that in Discord under Server Settings → Community. Everything else works.

creates.title: What the bot creates
creates.text: Everything with a symbol and in your colours. It takes over what already exists – nothing is created twice, and it leaves alone whatever it didn't create itself.

roles.title: Roles
roles.text: All ranks from your role template in order and colour, with the symbol in the name (♛ Owner, ⚔ Moderator …) – plus “🤖 Bot”, “✔ Verbunden”, “🔇 Stumm” and “⛓ Gefängnis”.

info.title: 📢 Info
info.text: Welcome with picture and address, rules from the panel, announcements, news from the website, a status channel with one live message per mode and the game modes with a link.

help.title: 🎫 Help
help.text: Help with /hilfe and buttons, tickets (a button opens a private conversation just for you and the team) and applications for the team and for MorniCraft.

voice.title: 🔊 Voice
voice.text: The same voice channels as in the game – reachable from every mode.

team.title: 🛡 Team
team.text: Team chat, team log, application inbox (with accept/reject) and punishment log – team only. Plus areas for the build team and VIPs.

extras.title: ⛓ Jail and commands
extras.text: Whoever is in jail only sees the jail channel. Plus /verbinden, /hilfe, /status and /bewerben.

look.title: 🎨 Look
look.text: The MoinMorni logo as server picture and as the bot's avatar – you swap both under “Look”.

creates.safe: Tip: you can press “Set up the server” again at any time, e.g. after new roles or voice channels.

discordAccess.envHint: This value is in the .env on the server and applies. You can only change or remove it there (then restart MoinMorni).
discordAccess.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
discordAccess.privacy: Stored encrypted and never shown again – not even to you.

token.label: Bot token
token.help: Paste the token from the developer portal (Bot → Reset Token) here:
token.removed: Bot token removed – the bot is offline now.
token.removeText: The bot goes offline until you enter a new token. Roles and channels in Discord stay as they are.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.help: Paste the client secret (OAuth2 → Reset Secret) here:
clientSecret.saved: Client secret saved – “Sign in with Discord” is on.
clientSecret.removed: Client secret removed – “Sign in with Discord” is off.
clientSecret.removeText: Then nobody can sign in with Discord on the website any more – applications only work through the Discord bot.

discordSetup.waitTitle: Discord slows down for a moment
discordSetup.waitText: Discord only allows a certain number of changes per minute. It goes on by itself in {{seconds}} s.

error.discord_missing_permissions: The bot is missing rights. Invite it again with the button in step 4 (Discord then asks for the missing ones) and start the setup again.
error.discord_no_guild: The bot isn't on a Discord server any more. Invite it first (step 4).
error.discord_not_configured: There's no bot token any more (step 1).
error.discord_unreachable: Discord can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment – what's already there stays.
error.discord_failed: Discord turned down a change. Try again – what's already there stays.
error.other: Something went wrong. Try again – what's already there stays.

discordSetup.doneTitle: Done – your Discord is set up!
discordSetup.doneText: {{roles}} roles, {{channels}} channels and categories and {{messages}} messages are there – {{created}} of them new.
discordSetup.kept: Left as they are because you changed them in Discord: {{names}}
discordSetup.iconKept: Your own server picture stays. You can set the MoinMorni logo under “Look” if you like.
discordSetup.iconFailed: The server picture couldn't be set – you can also do that under “Look”.
discordSetup.ownerAdminText: A bot may not give out the “Administrator” right. Give it to the owner role yourself once: Server Settings → Roles → Owner → Permissions → Administrator.
discordSetup.someMissing: The important parts are there, but the bot is missing: {{rights}}. Invite it again via step 4 and the next sync gets everything.

discordLook.title: Look
discordLook.text: How your Discord looks: server picture, banner and the bot's profile. At first, the MoinMorni logo is everywhere.
discordLook.notReady: As soon as the bot is connected (step 1), you change the server picture, banner and the bot's profile here.
discordLook.noGuild: The bot isn't on a Discord server yet (step 4).
discordLook.noBot: The bot isn't connected right now.

icon.title: Server picture
icon.text: The round picture in the server list. PNG, JPG or GIF up to 10 MB – you crop it right here.
icon.animatedOk: Moving GIFs work on your server (boost level 1).
icon.animatedNo: Moving GIFs only work from boost level 1 – otherwise a GIF becomes a still picture.

banner.title: Server banner
banner.text: The wide picture at the top of the channel list (16:9).
banner.locked: Banners need boost level {{need}} – your server has level {{tier}}.

bot.title: Bot profile
bot.text: The avatar and name the bot writes with on Discord.
bot.name: Bot name
bot.limit: Discord only allows a few changes to the bot per hour (the name only twice). If it says “too often”, just try again later.

crop.text: Move it with the mouse, your finger or the arrow keys; bigger and smaller with the slider.
crop.wrongType: That only works with PNG, JPG or GIF pictures.
crop.tooBig: The picture is too big – up to 10 MB works.
crop.unreadable: The picture couldn't be opened. Try another one.
crop.movingOk: Your server may show moving pictures. Take it unchanged and it keeps moving – cropping turns it into a still picture.

movingNo.square: Moving server pictures need boost level 1 – the GIF is saved as a still picture.
movingNo.banner: Moving banners need boost level 3 – the GIF is saved as a still picture.

teamAdmin.title: Team
teamAdmin.text: Everyone who may use the panel. Create new accounts, change roles, reset forgotten passwords or lock an account.
teamAdmin.twoFactorHelp: Signs in in two steps: password plus a code from their phone.
teamAdmin.startPasswordHelp: Hasn't set an own password yet – that happens at the first sign-in.

how.title: How it works
how.login: Every team member signs in here with their own username and password:
how.roles: What someone sees in the panel and may do in the game depends on their role. You set up the roles themselves under “Roles”.
how.security: Passkeys and two-step sign-in are set up by each person under “My account”.

create.title: New team account
create.text: The person gets a start password. At the first sign-in they set their own.
create.usernameHelp: This is what the person signs in with: 3 to 32 characters – letters, digits, dot, underscore or dash.
create.usernameInvalid: Only letters without accents, digits, dot, underscore and dash, please – at least 3 characters.
create.emailHelp: Only for “forgot password”. Can stay empty – the person can add it later.
create.roleHelp: You can only give roles below your own (the owner can give all). Ranks without the panel (e.g. VIP or Media) don't need an account – give those under “Players”.
create.noRoles: There's no role you may give. Create roles with panel areas under “Roles”.

result.text: Give {{name}} these sign-in details – ideally in person or by direct message. You only see the start password now.
result.change: At the first sign-in, {{name}} has to set their own password. After that the start password no longer works.

reset.title: New password for {{name}}?
reset.text: {{name}} gets a new start password. The old password stops working, and at the next sign-in {{name}} has to set their own.
reset.secondFactorsHelp: Only needed if {{name}} lost their phone or security key. Afterwards {{name}} sets both up again under “My account”.

disableConfirm.title: Lock {{name}}?
disableConfirm.text: {{name}} can no longer sign in until you unlock the account. If they are signed in right now, they are signed out.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}'s account?
removeConfirm.text: The account is deleted – with password, passkeys and 2FA. {{name}} can no longer sign in, and the team role no longer counts in the game either. This can't be undone.

account.title: My account
account.text: Your access to the panel: Minecraft account, password, passkeys, two-step sign-in and email.
account.roleText: Your role decides what you see in the panel and may do in the game. Someone with a higher role can change it.
account.minecraftText: Enter your Minecraft name (Java Edition) below. Then MoinMorni recognises you in the game, and your team role counts there too – with its symbol in the chat and the rights of your role.
account.minecraftLinked: MoinMorni recognises you in the game: your team role counts there too – with its symbol in the chat and the rights of your role.

password.title: Password
password.text: At least 10 characters. Pick one you don't use anywhere else.

passkey.title: Passkey
passkey.text: Sign in without a password – with your fingerprint, face or your device's PIN. Safer than any password.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in (2FA)
twoFactor.text: After the password the panel asks for a code from an app on your phone (e.g. Aegis or Google Authenticator). Someone who only knows your password can't get in.

email.title: Email
email.text: Only for “forgot password” and important notices. Optional.

updatesCard.title: MoinMorni version
updatesCard.text: New versions come from GitHub, where MoinMorni’s code lives. Every update starts with a backup – if something goes wrong, MoinMorni goes back to the old version by itself.
updatesCard.newer: Newer than yours – the list of changes tells how much.
updatesCard.motorUnknown: Whether there is something new is not known right now.
updatesCard.motorBehind_one: MorniHosting has {{count}} newer change ({{latest}}). It comes along when
updatesCard.motorBehind_other: MorniHosting has {{count}} newer changes ({{latest}}). They come along when
updatesCard.motorNewer: MorniHosting has something new ({{latest}}). It comes along when
updatesCard.noAgentTitle: Update helper missing on this machine
updatesCard.noAgentText: The panel cannot replace itself – a small helper on the machine does that, set up by install.sh (needs systemd). It is missing here, so automatic updates do not run either. Until then, start an update on the machine yourself:
updatesCard.checkFailedTitle: GitHub cannot be reached right now
updatesCard.checkFailedText: We could not check whether there is something new. Usually GitHub or the machine’s internet is the reason – MoinMorni keeps running as usual. Try again in a few minutes.
updatesCard.checkFailedToast: GitHub is not answering right now – try again later.
updatesCard.branchMissingToast: The channel “{{branch}}” doesn’t exist on GitHub.
updatesCard.branchMissingTitle: The channel “{{branch}}” doesn’t exist on GitHub (yet)
updatesCard.branchMissingText: MoinMorni follows this branch on GitHub but can’t find it there – maybe it was merged or renamed. MM_UPDATE_BRANCH in the .env on the machine sets the channel (main otherwise). MoinMorni keeps running as usual.
updatesCard.pendingTitle: The list of changes is on its way
updatesCard.pendingText: There is a new version – only GitHub didn’t send the list of what changed just now. MoinMorni asks again in a few minutes.
updatesCard.pendingCanStart: You can start the update anyway.
updatesCard.limitedTitle: GitHub won’t let us ask more often right now – the list of changes comes at {{time}}
updatesCard.limitedText: Without signing in, GitHub answers only 60 questions per hour per internet address, and every machine at your place shares it. MoinMorni still sees whether there is something new – it asks GitHub another way for that.
updatesCard.limitedKeyTip: Tip: with a read-only GitHub key (MM_GITHUB_TOKEN in the .env) it’s 5000 questions per hour. How to set it up: quick-start guide, part 8 “Updates”.
updatesCard.keyRejectedTitle: GitHub doesn’t accept the key from the .env
updatesCard.keyRejectedText: MM_GITHUB_TOKEN has expired, was deleted or copied wrongly. Until then MoinMorni asks without it (60 questions per hour). Put a new key into the .env on the machine and restart MoinMorni – or delete the line.
updatesCard.currentToast: Up to date – nothing to do.
updatesCard.startedToast: Update started. You can follow it here.
updatesCard.stuckTitle: The update helper does not answer
updatesCard.stuckText: The request has been waiting for over 2 minutes, but nobody picks it up. Check on the machine whether the update helper is running:
updatesCard.waitingText: The update helper on the machine starts in a moment – usually just a few seconds.

stepNow.build: Building the new version – this takes a few minutes
stepNow.rollback: Going back to the old version

updatesCard.rollingBack: Something went wrong – MoinMorni is going back to the old version by itself (code and databases from the backup).
updatesCard.reconnecting: MoinMorni is restarting – the page reconnects in a moment.

rolled_back.title: Last update was undone ({{time}})
rolled_back.text: Something went wrong with the new version. So MoinMorni went back to the old version ({{from}}) by itself – including the databases from the backup. Everything runs as before; the log shows what happened.

failed.title: Last update failed ({{time}})
failed.text: The log shows what happened. If only the new code could not be fetched, MoinMorni keeps running unchanged ({{from}}). Otherwise please look at the machine – backups are in /var/backups/moinmorni.

updatesCard.allCurrentText: You have the newest version of MoinMorni – nothing to do.
updatesCard.devBuild: This version was built without a version number, so MoinMorni cannot compare what is new.

confirm.title: Start the update now?
confirm.text: Website and panel are unreachable for 1–2 minutes. The Minecraft servers keep running.
confirm.step1: The new code is fetched and built – the old version keeps running meanwhile.
confirm.step2: Backup of the databases (worlds have their own backups).
confirm.step3: Restart with the new version, then a check.
confirm.step4: If something goes wrong, it goes back to the old version by itself.

applicationsCard.noRight: Deciding is for those who may kick in the game (moderator and above) – just like the buttons in Discord.
applicationsCard.title: Applications
applicationsCard.text: Who wants to join MorniCraft. People apply on the website (with Discord sign-in) and in Discord with /bewerben. Accepting puts the name on the whitelist.
applicationsCard.emptyClosed: Applications are closed right now. Turn on “Applications open” below to get new ones.
applicationsCard.acceptText: {{name}} goes on the whitelist and can join MorniCraft right away. With Discord, {{name}} gets the “message on acceptance” (set below) as a direct message – and in game, if online right now.
applicationsCard.rejectText: {{name}} gets a kind rejection as a Discord message and can apply again later.
applicationsCard.noteAcceptPlaceholder: e.g. we know them from Discord
applicationsCard.noteAcceptHelp: Only the team sees it (here and in the #bewerbungen channel) – {{name}} does not.
applicationsCard.noteRejectPlaceholder: e.g. Please tell us a bit more about yourself.
applicationsCard.noteRejectHelp: Part of the message to {{name}} – please stay kind.
applicationsCard.acceptedToast: {{name}} is accepted and on the whitelist.
applicationsCard.noAccess: Applications and the whitelist are for roles with the panel area “Players”. Ask the owner if you need them.

applications.title: Applications
applications.text: Who wants to join the team or play on MorniCraft. The answers, the team's thumbs and notes – and your decision.
applications.noOpenPositions: No team position is open right now.
applications.openPositionsHint: Open positions show on the website under Team and in Discord with “/bewerben”.
applications.votesText: What does the team think? Only the team sees the thumbs – the applicant doesn't.
applications.notesText: Team only – the applicant never sees them.
applications.messagePlaceholder: e.g. “Welcome to the team! Drop by #team-chat.”
applications.messageHelp: Optional. Arrives as a Discord message, in the game and on the website.
applications.account: Create a team account for the panel
applications.accountText: With a start password and the role {{role}} – on first sign-in the person sets their own password.
applications.acceptText: {{name}} gets the rank {{role}} – in the game, on Discord and everywhere in the network – plus your message on Discord and in the game.
applications.acceptTextMornicraft: {{name}} goes on the MorniCraft whitelist and gets your message on Discord and in the game.
applications.rejectText: {{name}} gets your message on Discord. A new application only works after the waiting time.
applications.accountConfirm: The panel account “{{username}}” is created as well. You see the start password right after.
applications.noRight: Only someone who may give out the rank {{role}} decides on this position. You can give thumbs and write notes.
applications.noRightMornicraft: You don't decide on this one. You can give thumbs and write notes.
applications.settingsText: Applications come in through the website (Team → Apply) and Discord (/bewerben, button in the “Bewerbungen” channel). You read and decide them in the panel under “Applications” and on Discord in the application inbox. VIP and owner are never given through an application.

whitelistCard.noRight: Adding and removing names is for those who may kick in the game (moderator and above) – just like accepting applications.
whitelistCard.title: Whitelist
whitelistCard.text: Who may join MorniCraft. The team always gets in and shows up here by itself: everyone whose rank has “Always gets in”. Accepted applications land here by themselves too; you can also add names directly.
whitelistCard.addHelp: As it shows in game. Bedrock players (phone, console, Windows) with a dot in front, e.g. .Lena
whitelistCard.invalidName: That is not a valid Minecraft name: 3–16 letters, digits or _ – Bedrock players with a dot in front (e.g. .Lena).
whitelistCard.seenHelp: Has joined MorniCraft with this name – the spot now belongs to this account, even after a name change.
whitelistCard.removeText: {{name}} can no longer join MorniCraft from the next visit on. You can add the name again at any time.
whitelistCard.empty: Nobody on the whitelist yet. Accept an application or add a name.
whitelistCard.teamHelp: Gets in through the rank, no entry needed. Who belongs is set under “Roles” (right “Always gets in”).
whitelistCard.notSeen: not in the network yet – name of the panel account
whitelistCard.alreadyTeam: {{name}} belongs to the team and gets in anyway.

buildCard.title: Saved builds
buildCard.text: What the build team saves with WorldEdit on the build server lands here. With one click you copy a build into the lobby or a mode – someone places it there with WorldEdit.
buildCard.missingTitle: The build server does not exist yet
buildCard.missingText: MoinMorni creates it by itself when it sets up the network (together with proxy and lobby). If it is missing here, the setup is still running or it was deleted in the engine – it is created again at the next start of MoinMorni.
buildCard.howTitle: How the build team saves a build
buildCard.how1: Go to the build server (only with the right “build”):
buildCard.how2b: and mark two corners of the build: left click = first corner, right click = second.
buildCard.how3b: – where you stand is the point where the build is placed later.
buildCard.how4b: (instead of “rathaus” your own name without spaces). Then the build shows up here.
buildCard.empty: No builds saved yet. As soon as someone saves with //schem save, the build shows up here.
buildCard.noTargets: There is no lobby or mode with its own server to copy into yet.
buildCard.copyText: The build lands in the WorldEdit folder of the chosen server. It only enters the world when someone places it there.
buildCard.after1: Go to {{target}} in game (it needs WorldEdit and the right for it there).
buildCard.after3: Place it where you want with
buildCard.after3b: – the build appears where you stand.

apply.title: Apply for MorniCraft
apply.text: MorniCraft is our friends’ survival with clans, graves and a mighty dragon – invitation only. Tell us a bit about yourself; the team answers you on Discord.

loginError.discord_login_off: Discord sign-in is not set up right now. Please apply directly in Discord with /bewerben.
loginError.discord_login_failed: The Discord sign-in did not work – maybe it was cancelled or took too long. Just try again.

signIn.title: First sign in with Discord
signIn.text: That way we know whom to answer. You get the team’s answer as a Discord message.
signIn.privacy: We only see your Discord name – no password, no messages, no servers. The sign-in lasts 2 hours and only for this page.

form.title: Your application
form.name: Your Minecraft name
form.nameHelp: Exactly as it shows in game. Playing on phone, console or Windows (Bedrock)? Then with a dot in front, e.g. .Lena
form.nameBedrock: Bedrock name recognised. Write spaces in your player name as _.
form.nameProblem: That does not fit yet: 3–16 letters, digits or _ – for Bedrock with a dot in front (e.g. .Lena).
form.aboutPlaceholder: Who are you, what do you like to play, what do you like to build?
form.aboutHelp: A few sentences are enough (at least {{min}} characters).
form.aboutProblem: Please write a little more – at least {{min}} characters.
form.whyPlaceholder: What draws you to MorniCraft? Do you already know someone here?
form.whyHelp: Be honest – there are no wrong answers.
form.whyProblem: Please write briefly why you want to join.
form.ageHelp: Numbers only. Only the team sees it.
form.ageProblem: Numbers only, please (e.g. 15) – or leave it empty.
form.who: The team sees your answers and your Discord name ({{name}}).

status.name: Minecraft name
status.pendingTitle: Your application is with the team
status.pendingText: Thank you! We read every application ourselves and answer you with a Discord message.
status.pendingTip: For our answer to arrive, be on our Discord server – Discord only delivers messages from the bot then.
status.acceptedText: {{name}} is on the whitelist – you can start right away. How to get there:
status.acceptedHow: In the lobby, click the figure “MorniCraft” – or type in chat:
status.rejectedTitle: It did not work out this time
status.rejectedText: You got the team’s answer as a Discord message. Don’t be sad – you are welcome to apply again later.
status.againLater: We are not taking new applications right now. Come back later.

closed.title: No applications right now
closed.text: We are not taking new applications at the moment. Come back later – we will tell you in Discord as soon as it opens again.

noLogin.title: Applying only works in Discord right now
noLogin.text: Discord sign-in is not set up on the website yet. In Discord it works anyway: use the button in the help channel or type

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: So we know whom to answer.
how.step2Text: Your Minecraft name and a few sentences about you.
how.step3Text: Usually within a few days. The answer comes as a Discord message.
how.step4Text: If accepted, your name is on the whitelist – MorniCraft is open for you right away.

apply.fair: Every application is read by real people from the team. Applying is free – a spot cannot be bought.

teamApply.title: Apply for the team
teamApply.text: Want to help shape MoinMorni – as a moderator, supporter, builder or media? Sign in with Discord, pick a position and tell us about yourself.

signIn.title: Sign in with Discord
signIn.text: That way we know whom to answer: our reply comes as a Discord message. Then you see the open positions and the form.

teamApply.noLogin: Applications currently go through our Discord bot: type there

closed.title: We're not looking right now
closed.text: No team position is open at the moment. Come back later – open positions also show on the team page and on Discord.

pending.title: Your application is with the team
pending.text: Thanks! The team is looking at it. You get the answer as a Discord message – and here on this page.

cooldown.title: Just a little wait
cooldown.text: After a rejection you can apply again from {{date}}. Until then: have fun on the network!

link.title: Link your Minecraft account first
link.text: To apply for the team we need your Minecraft account – linked to your Discord. Here's how:
link.step3: Reload this page – and off you go.

form.title: Your application
form.nameHelp: The name you play with on our network. Best link your account in the game with /discord.
form.notReady: Something is still missing – check the fields marked in red.
form.who: Sent as {{name}} (Discord). The team sees your Discord name, your Minecraft name and your answers.

how.step1: Sign in and pick a position
how.step1Text: Sign in with Discord, pick a position, answer honestly – there are no wrong answers.
how.step2Text: The team looks at your application. That usually takes a few days.
how.step3Text: If it's a yes, you get your rank in the game and on Discord right away. After a rejection you can apply again after {{days}} days.

teamApply.fair: VIP and owner are never given through an application – and none of it can be bought. We decide by what you write and how you play on the network.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalid_credentials: Name or password is not right.
errors.invalid_code: The code is not right. Use the current one from your app.
errors.no_pending_login: The sign-in has expired. Please start again.
errors.email_unconfirmed: Please confirm your email address first.
errors.account_pending_approval: Your account is still waiting for approval.
errors.not_in_team: Your account has no role in MoinMorni yet.
errors.panel_area_forbidden: Your role may not change this area.
errors.csrf: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.bad_origin: The request came from another site and was refused.
errors.invalid_request: One of the inputs does not fit yet.
errors.settings_invalid: A value is outside the allowed range.
errors.settings_area_unknown: This settings area does not exist.
errors.mode_unknown: This mode does not exist (any more).
errors.motor_unreachable: The motor (the server management) is not answering right now.
errors.internal: An error happened in the panel. Please try again in a moment.
errors.too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.passkey_unknown: MoinMorni does not know this passkey.
errors.setup_code_wrong: The setup code is not right. Have another close look.
errors.setup_done: MoinMorni is already set up. Just sign in.
errors.setup_invalid: Name or password do not fit the rules yet.
errors.player_unknown: MoinMorni does not know this player. They must have been on the network at least once – check the spelling too.
errors.player_higher: This person has the same or a higher rank than you – you may not do that.
errors.player_offline: Kicking only works while the person is online.
errors.punish_no_right: Your role may not hand out or lift this punishment – it lacks the right, just like the command in the game (e.g. “Mute in voice chat” for /voicemute).
errors.punishment_none: There is nothing to lift right now – maybe the punishment has already run out.
errors.role_unknown: This rank does not exist (any more). Reload the page.
errors.role_too_high: You may not give this rank – it is as high as yours or higher (VIP is given by the owner only).
errors.mornicraft_no_right: The MorniCraft whitelist and its applications are handled by those who may kick in the game (moderator and above) – in the panel just like in Discord.
errors.rank_no_right: You may not give ranks – your role needs the right “Give ranks”.
errors.role_owner_only: Only the owner may change Owner and Admin.
errors.role_duplicate: Two roles have the same ID. Give one of them another name.
errors.role_fallback_one: Exactly one role must be “for everyone else”.
errors.role_owner_missing: The owner role has to stay.
errors.news_unknown: This post doesn't exist (anymore). Reload the page.
errors.discord_no_guild: The bot isn't on a Discord server yet. Invite it first (step 4).
errors.discord_not_configured: There's no bot token yet. Start with step 1.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken. Please pick another one.
errors.email_taken: This email address already belongs to another account.
errors.team_higher: That's not possible: the role is as high as yours or higher. Only the owner may do that.
errors.team_not_self: You don't change your own account here – set your password and sign-in under “My account”.
errors.team_last_owner: There always has to be at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
errors.team_role_fallback: The role “for everyone else” isn't a team rank. Please pick another one.
errors.team_role_no_panel: This role sees nothing in the panel – it doesn't need an account. Give ranks like VIP under “Players”.
errors.team_member_unknown: This account doesn't exist (anymore). Reload the page.
errors.update_no_agent: The update helper is missing on the machine – install.sh sets it up.
errors.application_decided: Someone already decided on this application – maybe in Discord just now. The list is up to date now.
errors.application_unknown: This application does not exist (any more). Reload the page.
errors.whitelist_entry_unknown: This name is no longer on the whitelist.
errors.build_server_missing: The build server does not exist right now – so nothing can be copied.
errors.build_target_unknown: This target does not exist (any more). Reload the page and choose another one.
errors.applications_closed: We are not taking applications right now. Come back later.
errors.application_already_listed: This name is already on the whitelist – you can start playing right away!
errors.application_pending: There is already an application from you or for this Minecraft name. We will get back to you!
errors.apply_login_required: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in with Discord again – the page remembers your answers.
errors.application_no_right: You may not give out this position – only someone who may give out the rank (and never above their own).
errors.application_player_unknown: The network doesn't know this Minecraft name yet. The person has to visit MoinMorni once, then it works.
errors.application_rank_not_higher: The person already has this or a higher rank – accepting would demote them.
errors.discord_animated_needs_boost: Moving pictures need a boost – take a still picture (PNG or JPG).
errors.discord_credential_from_env: This value is in the .env on the server – you can only change it there.
errors.discord_failed: Discord turned that down. Try again in a moment.
errors.discord_image_invalid: Discord didn't accept the picture. Use a PNG, JPG or GIF.
errors.discord_image_too_big: The picture is too big for Discord – up to 10 MB works.
errors.discord_missing_permissions: The bot is missing a right for that (e.g. “Manage server”). Invite it again under Discord → step 4.
errors.discord_name_invalid: That name doesn't work: 2 to 32 characters, without @ # : and `.
errors.discord_owner_only: Only the owner changes the bot token and client secret.
errors.discord_rate_limited: Discord saw that too often in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.discord_secret_format: That doesn't look like a client secret. Copy it again in the developer portal (OAuth2 → Reset Secret).
errors.discord_secret_invalid: This client secret doesn't belong to this bot. Copy it from the same application in the developer portal.
errors.discord_token_format: That doesn't look like a bot token. Copy it again in the developer portal (Bot → Reset Token).
errors.discord_token_invalid: Discord doesn't know this token. Create a new one in the developer portal (Bot → Reset Token).
errors.discord_token_not_bot: That's not a bot token. You find the right one in the developer portal under “Bot”.
errors.discord_unreachable: Discord can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.note_invalid: The note is empty or too long.
errors.setting_owner_only: Only the owner can change this.
errors.team_account_no_right: You may not create a panel account with this role. Accept the application without an account.
errors.team_apply_answers: Please answer every question (each up to 1000 characters).
errors.team_apply_closed: This position isn't open right now. Reload the page.
errors.team_apply_cooldown: After a rejection, a new application only works after the waiting time.
errors.team_apply_link_required: Link your Minecraft account to Discord first (/discord in the game).
errors.team_apply_minecraft_name: That's not a valid Minecraft name.
errors.team_apply_pending: Your application is already with the team – you'll hear from us soon.
errors.team_position_unknown: This position doesn't exist (any more). Reload the page.
errors.player_protected: Punishments only go to lower ranks: this person has the same or a higher rank than you (nobody punishes the Owner).

modeSettings.title: Applies after the mode’s next restart
modeSettings.text: These settings live in the game mode’s own file. MoinMorni writes them there and restarts the mode by itself as soon as nobody is playing – nobody gets thrown out mid-game. If the mode is asleep, they apply when it wakes up.
modeSettings.pendingText: The new values are written. Someone is still playing – as soon as the mode is empty it restarts, then they apply.

reach.ownerOnly: Only the owner sets up NetBird, the website on the domain and “hide the home connection” – they are admin in the engine.
